Lesson 12. The Bass Clef

The F clef indicates the F line on a staff by placing its two dots on either side of the fourth line. It is also called bass clef (pronounced “base”).

= bass clef

Bass Clef Notes In bass clef, the notes from F upward are F, G, A, and B. Downward from F, they are E, D, C, B, A, G, and F.

The range may be extended using ledger lines:

Stem direction for the bass clef is determined the same way as in treble: notes placed on or above the middle line (D) are notated with stems down; notes placed on or below the middle line are notated with stems up.

Practice

1. Practice drawing the bass clef sign in the measures provided.
